description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
